scene: Scene: First City of Atheus, old High Elven religious and cultural center in the fertile northern land of Horteon. View from a sheltered worn stone civic gallery with slender restrained pointed arches at left, across a modest old courtyard to layered pale stone halls and narrow tall windows among gardens, beyond which cultivated fields fade into cool distant hills. A lived-in ancient city, dignified but not impossibly grand. Weathered paving, sparse climbing greenery, soft cool northern daylight with a patch of pale warm light on the central court. No huge fantasy spires, magical glow, throne or sacred emblem. This is the pre-rebuilding historic city, not the mission's completed restoration.

scene: Scene: Gerrbaen, the Silver Dwarven complex of hillside farms and gardens on the Green Hills near province 3883. An empty shaded garden path and low rough masonry wall at left overlook an old network of practical stone terraces, modest farm plots, garden courts, fruit trees and water channels stepping up a green hill to the private royal gardens, Konungien, on the summit at middle-right. Solid human-scale dwarven stonework and simple timber garden shelters. Existing site with worn retaining walls and slightly overgrown corners, not its later restored expanded mission state. Gentle afternoon light, moss green, pale grey stone and muted earth. No exotic animals or Fai because these are only rumors, no palace dominating the hill, no giant statues, no imported dwarven runes.

scene: Scene: Great Silver Hold, Silver Dwarven mountain capital in the caverns of the Inner Dragon's Pass. View from an empty shaded low stone arcade at left into an inhabited underground district: robust carved stone houses, small market halls with closed wooden counters, ascending stone lanes, a few restrained civic buildings embedded in the natural cavern walls. Thin irregular seams of dull silver in dark rock and silver-lined stone walls explain its name. Modest amber oil lamps and cool reflected pale light from a distant high fissure reveal receding architecture through mineral haze. The cavern ceiling must be visible, clearly an UNDERGROUND city, no open mountain panorama. Existing city, before the later metropolis expansion; no academy, no giant abyss, no lava, no magic crystals, no monumental statues, no invented emblems or runes.
